name: 8th Wall
tagline: 8th Wall is a web-based augmented reality platform that lets brands and developers create AR experiences that run directly in the mobile browser without an app download. Marketing teams use it for product try-on experiences, interactive packaging, and location-based campaigns that users can access by scanning a QR code. Its SLAM-based world tracking works across iOS and Android without requiring ARKit or ARCore, making experiences accessible to a wider audience than native AR apps.
